subject: Marketplace reseller addendum — CloudNova pass-through language and Order Form alignment
messages:
From: CloudNova Partnerships <partners@cloudnova.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: lina.park@cloudnova.com
Date: 2026-10-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial redlines — Reseller Addendum (CloudNova marketplace listing)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Attached are our redlines to the reseller addendum that will sit alongside the Marketplace listing. High level: CloudNova needs explicit pass-through billing and taxation language so end-customers can be billed via our marketplace listing (we will credit Redwood for the net revenue). We also flagged a couple of insurance/indemnity items and a short audit window request (60 days after invoice).

We're aiming to close the commercial paper this month — can you route the attached to whoever handles partner legal so we can iterate quickly?

Attachments: CloudNova_Reseller_Addendum_20261018_redlines.pdf (PDF, 1 page summary + tracked changes)

Best,
Ethan Reyes
CloudNova, Head of Legal (Marketplace)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: partners@cloudnova.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial redlines — Reseller Addendum (CloudNova marketplace listing)

Ethan — thanks for the redlines and the clear summary. Looping in Marissa (sales/commercial), Jonas (partnerships lead), and Neha (legal) to review.

Quick asks from our side to speed this up:
- Marissa: confirm the intended discount/pass-through mechanics so Legal can map to Order Form templates (are marketplace fees being deducted before revenue share calculation?).
- Neha: can you take the redlines and suggest alternative language where the request conflicts with our standard marketplace pass-through policy?
- Jonas: we'll need an updated partner paper entry for our marketplace portal; can you confirm where this will be published and any timing constraints?

We have an open DocuSign Order Form draft (RNW_DocuSign_OrderForm_v3.docx). If legal can sign off on the addendum text, we'll push the order form via DocuSign and proceed to listing.

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-19T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial redlines — Reseller Addendum (CloudNova marketplace listing)

Thanks, Hannah. I reviewed CloudNova's redlines (attached) and flagged a few items that need negotiation before we can accept as-is. Summary of material points: 

1) Pass-through billing language: CloudNova's version would make Redwood responsible for tax calculations even when billing is routed through the partner marketplace. We need language that clarifies (a) the billing entity (CloudNova) remains the invoicing party for marketplace-billed customers, and (b) Redwood's tax obligations will be limited to amounts reflected on invoices we actually receive. I drafted alternative wording in RNW_marketable_pass_through_clause_v1.docx.

2) Liability & indemnity: their redline expands indemnity to cover third-party marketplace fees. We should cap indemnity exposure to direct damages and exclude consequential damages; if they insist on marketplace fee indemnity, request a monetary cap tied to the order value.

3) Audit window: 60 days post-invoice is unusually short for us (we typically require 120 days for disputed charges). If they need faster turnaround for reconciliation we can propose a joint reconciliation process plus a 60-day exception limited to billing disputes only.

4) Order Form reference: their suggested language references a "marketplace listing fee" that does not match how our Order Form templates encode pass-through (we typically put pass-through on a per-line item with a qualifier). We'll need Marissa to confirm the commercial mechanics so I can map to the RNW_DocuSign_OrderForm_v3.docx.

Next steps (proposed):
- Hannah/Jon: confirm marketplace billing flow and whether CloudNova will remit taxes or provide validated tax invoices.
- Marissa: confirm whether pass-through amounts are deducted pre- or post-revenue-share (affects cap language).
- I will circulate a single redline that reconciles CloudNova's commercial asks with our legal guardrails by EOD Thursday.

Attachments: RNW_marketable_pass_through_clause_v1.docx

-Neha
Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-21T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial redlines — Reseller Addendum (CloudNova marketplace listing)

Quick commercial clarifications from our side after sync with finance:
- Marketplace fees: CloudNova will deduct marketplace service fees before remitting net to Redwood. That net amount is what should feed into our revenue-share calculation.
- Taxes: CloudNova will handle collection on marketplace-billed orders in their role as the marketplace operator; they will provide tax invoices to Redwood that reflect amounts remitted.
- Discount/credits: any partner discounts must be applied on CloudNova's side prior to calculation of the net remittance.

Given the above, Neha's approach (billing entity remains CloudNova; Redwood's obligations limited to invoices we receive) is acceptable commercially. The only remaining ask is a concession on the audit window: finance can accept 90 days instead of 120 if CloudNova provides a quarterly reconciliation report.

If Neha can incorporate these points into the consolidated redline, we can send back to CloudNova and propose a short call if they push further.

-Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Reyes <ereyes@cloudnova.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial redlines — Reseller Addendum (CloudNova marketplace listing)

Hannah / team — thanks for the detailed review and the proposed approach. We’re comfortable with the clarified billing entity language and the 90-day audit window paired with quarterly reconciliation. Regarding indemnity: CloudNova can accept a carve-out for consequential damages and will agree to a mutual cap tied to the total fees paid under the Order Form in the prior 12 months.

Please send over Neha's consolidated redline and the DocuSign Order Form when ready. Once we have the DocuSign, CloudNova will route to our marketplace operations and legal for final sign-off; we can then publish the marketplace listing the following week.

DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.net/recipient/1234abcdef

Thanks,
Ethan Reyes
CloudNova, Head of Legal (Marketplace)
